description: Demolition of existing and erection of a single storey outbuilding in rear garden
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Existing GA 01, Unnumbered Existing GA 02, Unnumbered Proposed GA, Unnumbered Proposed Site Plan & Location Plan, Fire Statement, Proposed Site Plan & Location Plan (in support of Fire Statement) Received: 26 October 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby permitted at the address 29 Worton Gardens, TW7 4BD shall not be used other than for purposes incidental to the occupation of the main dwelling and for the avoidance of doubt shall not be used as primary living accommodation such as a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or living room or for business purposes.
